title: Book One · Chapter 7: The Boy by the Window
story:
The empty chair is beside a boy at the window.

Miss Wu puts Ronan's bag on it.

"This is your place for now. Leo, move your things over, please."

Leo's things cover the desk. There is a pencil and a stone. There are three paper squares, too. He moves the pencil. He leaves the stone.

Ronan sits down. One corner of his bag touches a paper square.

"That's mine," Leo says.

"I didn't take it."

"You're on it."

"My bag is on it."

"It's your bag."

Ronan lifts the bag. Leo pulls the paper away. There is a line down the desk. Ronan puts his finger on it.

"Is this your side?"

"Yes."

"The stone is on my side."

Leo looks at the stone. Slowly, he moves it across the line.

Miss Wu begins the lesson. Ronan looks at her. Then he looks at Leo. Leo is folding paper under the desk. A white corner goes up. Another corner goes down.

Ronan looks away. Then he looks back.

"What is it?" he whispers.

Leo covers it with his hand.

"A secret."

Miss Wu writes a number on the board. Ronan knows that number. He sits straighter.

Behind him, a child drops a whole box of pencils. They roll under the chairs. Miss Wu stops writing. Three children bend down at once, and their heads knock together.

"Just two helpers," she says. "Not everyone needs to get down there."

At break, Leo takes his paper out. It is a little bird with a flat head.

"It doesn't look like a bird," Ronan says.

"I need to finish it first."

Leo folds the head again. Now the head is almost gone.

Ronan tries not to smile. Leo sees him.

"You do it, then."

He puts another square across the desk. Ronan folds it in half. He folds it again. It becomes a thick white piece with no head at all.

"Mine is a sleeping bird," Ronan says.

"Very tired," Leo says.

They both laugh quietly. Leo looks at Ronan. Ronan smiles back. Their paper birds lie side by side. Leo's bird is small now. Ronan's flat bird is bigger. Leo points to it. "A big sleeping bird," he says.

At the door, a little child stands with a lunch bag. He looks at the desks. Then he looks at the number outside the room.

"Wrong class," Leo says.

The child's mouth opens. No words come out.

Leo stands up. "Come on. Your room is next door."

He takes the child to the other door. He waits until a teacher sees them. Then he comes back to the window.

"Do you know everybody?" Ronan asks.

"No. I know the room next door."

Leo sits down and touches the stone.

"My dad found this near the station. He works there. See the white line?"

Ronan looks closely. The stone has a thin white ring around it.

"Can I hold it?"

Leo gives it to him. It is cool and quite heavy.

Ronan puts the stone back in the same place. He takes the flat sleeping bird from his side of the desk.

"Can you show me the first fold?" he asks.

Leo puts a new square between them. This time it lies across the line.
studyGuide:
## 先看情节提示也可以

Ronan和同桌Leo先争桌面位置，后来一起折纸，也看见Leo帮助走错教室的孩子。

## 从认词到读句子

1. **Leo / covers it / with his hand.** Leo／盖住它／用他的手；it指折纸。
2. **Ronan / puts the stone back / in the same place.** Ronan／把小石头放回／原来的位置。

---

重点表达：mine＝我的；folds＝折叠；secret＝秘密；stone＝石头。

理解问题：

1. Ronan 和 Leo 为哪件事争执？
2. Leo 后来做了什么，改变了 Ronan 对他的看法？

复现小提示：Leo的纸鸟小，Ronan的纸鸟更大。bigger在新情节里再出现一次，不是新添一种复杂句式。
